# H. — Web and AI Developer in Kenya

> Websites that build presence. Agents that deliver. Automations that make work convenient.
> https://saintlife.dev

## About

H. is run by Jonathan Kariuki, a developer in Kenya who builds static, accessible websites, LLM agents with scoped tools and retrieval over the client's own data, and event-driven automation pipelines, and keeps websites healthy and findable afterwards. Every project listed below is working code shown on this site; none are mockups.

Prices are published openly. A first consultation on WhatsApp is free, and sending a request through the site costs nothing: scope and final price are agreed before any work or payment.

### Pricing (KSh; setup prices are "from")
- Monthly for AI agents, automations and website add-ons: AI/platform usage passed on at cost + a management plan (Basic KSh 2,000 or Full KSh 3,500)
- Monthly for websites: hosting and domain at cost, plus an optional Website care package
- Websites: simple static KSh 30,000; business KSh 60,000; e-commerce KSh 250,000; custom-tailored to the client's budget (hosting at cost, Website care optional)
- AI agents: custom email agent KSh 6,000; website chat assistant KSh 10,000; custom AI agent KSh 25,000
- Automations: single workflow KSh 8,000; multi-step pipeline KSh 15,000
- Website add-ons for an existing website: AI assistant KSh 12,000; M-Pesa payments on your site KSh 20,000; WhatsApp order alerts KSh 12,000
- Website care (any website, no setup fee): search setup one-off KSh 6,000; Care Basic KSh 2,500/month; Care + Search KSh 4,000/month; Care Growth KSh 10,000/month. Covers backups, security, fixes, and keeping sitemap.xml, robots.txt and llms.txt current

## Projects

Each project has a case page (write-up plus an animated demo); most also have a separate live build.

### DRAPE — static e-commerce front end
- Case page: https://saintlife.dev/portfolio/drape/
- Live build: https://saintlife.dev/shop/
- Type: Website
- Summary: 31 SKUs across 6 categories, per-colour product imagery, size selection and a slide-out cart, all client-side. Tailwind CSS and plain JavaScript, no JS framework.

### Ember & Oak — restaurant site
- Case page: https://saintlife.dev/portfolio/ember-oak/
- Live build: https://saintlife.dev/websites/restaurant/
- Type: Website
- Summary: Mobile-first site with an editorial layout, in-place tabbed menu, dietary tags, gallery, opening hours and a reservation flow with a confirmation state.

### Email Support Agent — retrieval-grounded replies
- Case page: https://saintlife.dev/portfolio/email-support/
- Live build: https://saintlife.dev/agents/email-support/
- Type: LLM agent
- Summary: Takes support docs and an inbound email, locates the section that answers the question, and drafts a reply restricted to that source, with the citation shown.

### Competitor Analysis Agent — scored report and roadmap
- Case page: https://saintlife.dev/portfolio/competitor-analysis/
- Live build: https://saintlife.dev/agents/competitor-analysis/
- Type: LLM agent (structured output)
- Summary: Given a company and optional rivals, runs a seven-step analysis and returns a 0–100 score, strengths, gaps and an impact-ranked roadmap.

### Daily Briefing — scheduled pipeline
- Case page: https://saintlife.dev/portfolio/daily-briefing/
- Live build: https://saintlife.dev/workflows/daily-briefing/
- Type: Automation pipeline
- Summary: Six stages: cron trigger, topic headlines, local weather, two-sentence summaries per story by Claude, emailed digest, run log appended to Google Sheets.

### Email Autoresponder — event-driven Gmail pipeline
- Case page: https://saintlife.dev/portfolio/email-autoresponder/
- Live build: https://saintlife.dev/workflows/email-autoresponder/
- Type: Automation pipeline
- Summary: No human in the loop: polls Gmail every 30 seconds, parses and filters (drops newsletters and spam), retrieves the matching policy docs, drafts with Claude, replies in-thread, marks the message read and logs the run.

### WhatsApp + M-Pesa Store — payments and order alerts
- Case page: https://saintlife.dev/portfolio/whatsapp-mpesa/
- Type: Integration
- Summary: An online store using Safaricom's Daraja API for M-Pesa STK-push payments; once Safaricom's callback confirms payment, the order, receipt and delivery details are sent to the owner on WhatsApp via the WhatsApp Business Platform.

## Capabilities & stack

- Front end: semantic HTML, token-based CSS, plain JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, WebGL shaders, light/dark theming
- Refactors: accessibility fixes, render-blocking asset removal, Core Web Vitals
- LLM agents: Claude API (Anthropic), OpenAI, tool calling, structured outputs, retrieval over client documents
- Pipelines: Gmail API, Google Sheets API, Python, scheduled and event-driven runs with retries and run logs
- Payments and messaging: Safaricom Daraja (M-Pesa STK push), WhatsApp Business Platform
- Website care and search: sitemaps, robots.txt, llms.txt, canonical tags, structured data (FAQ), Google Search Console and Bing
